shellCommands.command: pwd && rg -n "disabled|shouldDirty|isDirty|dirtyFields" src/logic src/useForm.ts src/__tests__/useForm/formState.test.tsx | head -240
grep -RIn "type GetIsDirty\|GetIsDirty" src | head -30 && grep -RIn "_getDirty(" src/logic/createFormControl.ts
git diff -- src/logic/createFormControl.ts src/types/form.ts && node_modules/.bin/jest --config ./scripts/jest/jest.config.js src/__tests__/useForm/formState.test.tsx --runInBand
git diff --check && git diff --stat && git status --short

grep -n "should honor shouldDirty\|if (control._proxyFormState.isDirty\|const _getDirty\|if (!_options.disabled" src/__tests__/useForm/formState.test.tsx src/useForm.ts src/logic/createFormControl.ts | head -30

tail -c 1 src/logic/createFormControl.ts | od -An -t x1 && tail -c 1 src/types/form.ts | od -An -t x1 && tail -c 1 src/useForm.ts | od -An -t x1 && tail -c 1 src/__tests__/useForm/formState.test.tsx | od -An -t x1
